entries.zh: 褪色；掉色（颜色消退）
entries.en: to lose color; to fade
entries.notes: H 栏「电色」有疑（电/甩），R 栏残；义据 L「perder la color」与 M 音定。

entries.zh: 蚀本；做买卖亏本（在本钱上受损）
entries.en: to lose in a sale; to sell at a loss, losing one's capital
entries.notes: H 第二字「饴」疑为「蝕」，R 残，义兼采 L「perder en la venta」。

entries.zh: 折蚀本钱；资本减损
entries.en: to lose one's capital; to diminish one's stock
entries.notes: H 首字有疑（减/滅），M 首音节 biêr 与「减」不谐；R 空，义据 L。

entries.zh: 糟蹋吃食；因不加照管而把食物弄坏
entries.en: to spoil or waste food through neglect
entries.notes: H「打賴食」与 M 音不谐，疑为「拍損食」一类写法；R 空，义据 L。

entries.zh: 赌输；（争斗、比试中）落败
entries.en: to lose at gambling; to lose a fight or contest
entries.notes: M 首音节 pvà 与「賭」不谐（疑记「敗」音）；H 作赌输而 L 作 lucha，义域略异。

entries.zh: 因欠债不还而断了交情（交财而仁义绝）
entries.en: to lose a friendship by failing to repay a debt; to break with someone over money

entries.zh: 诉讼败诉；打官司输了
entries.en: to lose a lawsuit; to lose one's case
entries.notes: L 语序残缺（「el que el pleito」当是 perder el pleito）；H「行事」指涉讼之事，R 残。

entries.zh: 盈利大损；赚头蚀去大半
entries.en: to lose much of the profit
entries.notes: H 首字「飴」疑为「蝕」，M 中段 hiû 与「向」音未密合。

entries.zh: （盐等）在水中化散流失；消散
entries.en: to dissolve away and be lost, as salt in water; to dissipate
entries.notes: L「thiêne por capar」不可解，H/M「消散」为唯一可靠依据。

entries.zh: 因冒失之举而彼此败坏；相与败落
entries.en: to be ruined together through a rash venture
entries.notes: L「attrevutura man debados」讹误难通，义从 H/M「相敗」。

entries.zh: 错失时机；失机
entries.en: to miss the opportunity; to lose one's chance
entries.notes: L「perder la faca」与「失机」不合，疑 faca 为 ocasión 之讹。

entries.zh: 失于迎候；接待不周而失礼
entries.en: to fail in courtesy by not receiving someone properly; to slight a guest
entries.notes: H「失接」谓失迎失候，与 L 之 perder el respeto 义近而非全同。

entries.zh: 失体统；不成体统（对人失敬）
entries.en: to be improper or indecorous; to fail in respect
entries.notes: H「非体（非體）」谓不体面，与 L 之 perder el respeto 义近。

entries.zh: 失礼；有失恭敬
entries.en: to be disrespectful; to commit a breach of etiquette

entries.zh: 失信；因回报不周而失去信用
entries.en: to break one's word; to lose credit through poor reciprocation

entries.zh: 背约；违约而失信用
entries.en: to break an agreement; to go back on one's word
entries.notes: L 末尾残（「por lo mala」后缺），M「hûiàg」与「負」音有出入。

entries.zh: 败阵；战败
entries.en: to lose the battle; to be defeated on the field

entries.zh: 毁坏；因不加照管而损毁
entries.en: to ruin or damage something through neglect

entries.zh: 毁坏了；把东西弄坏、糟蹋掉
entries.en: to have spoiled or ruined something
entries.notes: H「壁」疑为「壞」，M 连书两 hûy 正合「毀壞」，R 残。

entries.zh: 废时误事；错过良机而失了生意
entries.en: to waste time and miss the good opportunity, losing the deal
entries.notes: R 残；H/M「廢時」即虚耗时机，与 L 之失良机相合。

entries.zh: 失落；丢失
entries.en: to be lost; to mislay

entries.zh: 不见；丢失不见、看不着了
entries.en: to be missing; to be no longer seen
